note: Town of Shellbrook campground just south of Highway 3 on the north edge of town, beside a playground and the town's outdoor pool, with the Hidden Hills golf course down the block; fire pits, picnic tables and firewood.  The attendant is in and out of the office: leave a voicemail. --Claude
